narrative.overview: A dark graphite media console where cover art is the only saturated object. Chrome is quiet, close to the content, and warm-tactile inside a precise grid. Light mode is the same room in warm paper.
keyCharacteristics: Warm graphite and paper, not blue-black and not pure white.
One copper accent for action, selection, and state.
Covers carry the colour; chrome carries the hierarchy.
Soft radii, hairline edges, short state shadows.
Dense in the library, generous only between sections.

rules.name: The Copper Rarity Rule
rules.body: Copper appears on one primary action and one selected state per region. It never becomes a background fill or decorative line.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: A section starts with a heading at its own size. No all-caps, letter-spaced kicker sits above it.

rules.name: The Matte-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: If nothing is hovered, focused, or elevated, it casts no decorative shadow.

dos: Do let cover art provide the colour; keep chrome to graphite, paper, and copper.
Do use the raised surface plus a hairline to show selection and grouping.
Do keep one primary action per region and give it an 8px radius, not a pill.
Do preserve the 4.5:1 contrast floor for body, dim, and button labels in both modes.
donts: Don't use purple-blue gradients, gradient text, glows, or blurred blobs.
Don't use all-caps letter-spaced eyebrows or decorative status pulses.
Don't paint a colored left border on cards, rows, or alerts.
Don't stack cards inside cards or give every surface a shadow at rest.
Don't use monospace outside code, commands, paths, and log output.
